continuity.arc_goal: Produce a focused, internally consistent RFC suite for State Graph and Links with precise implementation details — journal entries, new types, completion semantics, and cross-partition mechanics specified. Core RFC is scoped to linked workflows only, orthogonal concerns extracted to standalone RFCs. Success = RFC suite can guide implementation with no ambiguity on the model.

progress_update.summary: We conducted a deep plan review of the Linked Workflows RFC suite, going through each of 9 simplification opportunities interactively. The dialog produced major design clarifications: completion delivers Result<T,E> only (no inline graph), a new Completing invocation status variant, precise journal entry specification (OneWayCallCommand + CreateLink + AttachInvocationCommand), new response sink variants (Link, HandlerInvocation), a new LinkCompletionNotification message type, cross-partition links from day one, and onCompleted as object-only. We then updated all RFC documents to reflect these decisions, deleted the Content-Addressable Graphs RFC, and updated the bullet point design doc.
progress_update.goal: Produce a focused, internally consistent RFC suite for State Graph and Links with precise implementation details — journal entries, new types, completion semantics, and cross-partition mechanics all specified. Success = RFC can guide implementation with no ambiguity on the core model.
accomplished: Interactive plan review of 9 simplification opportunities — each discussed and resolved with the user
Specified exact journal entries for linked workflow creation: OneWayCallCommand + CreateLink + optional AttachInvocationCommand
Designed new types: ServiceInvocationResponseSink::Link, ServiceInvocationResponseSink::HandlerInvocation, LinkCompletionNotification message, InvocationStatus::Completing
Established that onCompleted is object-only (workflows just await), cross-partition is day-one, no framework timeout defaults

Updated all RFC documents: rewrote State Graph RFC, deleted Content-Addressable Graphs RFC, trimmed State Introspection RFC (removed speculative REST API), updated Future Design Ideas, updated bullet point design doc
progress_update.now: Just completed all document updates. All RFCs and design docs reflect the plan review decisions.
next_steps: Implementation planning — break the RFC into concrete implementation tasks
Link table schema design — fields, indexes, query patterns
Graph traversal API design — how parents inspect frozen state graphs of completed children
Prototype CreateLink journal entry and LinkCompletionNotification message flow
constraints: Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Completing is a new InvocationStatus variant — touches 29 files / 298 occurrences
Links stored in dedicated table, not state keys
onCompleted only for virtual objects — workflows await via AttachInvocationCommand
decisions: Completion delivers Result<T,E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
New InvocationStatus::Completing variant for 'handler done, waiting for linked children'
Journal entries: OneWayCallCommand (start child) + CreateLink (link table + register Link sink) + optional AttachInvocationCommand (explicit await or onCompleted)
New ServiceInvocationResponseSink::Link variant generates LinkCompletionNotification on child completion
New ServiceInvocationResponseSink::HandlerInvocation variant for onCompleted on virtual objects
LinkCompletionNotification is a new message type distinct from InvocationResponse
Children blocking parent completion is essential — not optional, not deferrable
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
No framework-level timeout defaults — owner controls via cancellation
Content-Addressable Graphs RFC deleted entirely — powerful idea for later, not essential now
State Introspection REST API removed — was speculative, needs its own design discussion
Link table stores the child's result directly — links outlive invocation retention
open_questions: Link table schema — what fields, indexes, and query patterns?
Graph traversal API — how does a parent inspect frozen state graph of completed children?
Completing variant internals — what data does it carry? InFlightInvocationMetadata? Return value? Active children count?
Orphan GC policy — default timeout for orphaned workflows?
risks: Completing variant touches 29 files — significant but compiler-guided ripple
Cross-partition link creation requires outbox coordination — adds latency to link setup
